rows.evidence: src/client/components/settings/catalog.test.ts:163 `for (const root of SYSTEM_ROOTS) expect(html).toContain(root.dir);` fails on the code as written. SYSTEM_ROOTS includes the `skills` root (src/shared/root-kinds.ts:298-308: source 'code', flags.agentDirectFs: true, dir `.claude4spec/skills`). AlwaysExcluded renders agentDeniedDirs(config.roots) (src/client/chat/settings/agentSettings.tsx:219), which filters to agentDirectFs=false (root-kinds.ts:354), so `.claude4spec/skills` is never in the HTML. That is correct per spec 8lk6hpxp ('korzeni z agentDirectFs = nie'). The test's expectation is wrong; it should iterate SYSTEM_ROOTS.filter(r => !agentDirectFs) or agentDeniedDirs(USER_ROOTS). The visibility assertions (lines 157-160, 166-169: always-excluded shown for block undefined/true/false, allowed/disallowed hidden when checked, always-excluded directly above disallowed-paths when unchecked) match the criterion and pass against the code.

src/client/components/settings/catalog.test.ts:112 `expect(elements.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['roots'])`, `expect(keys).toEqual(['roots'])`, no element with configKey plansDir/briefsDir/patchesDir/entitiesDir/releasesDir. Directories card = src/client/components/project/projectSettings.ts:79-88 (single 'roots' element). Window change only added verifies: settings-page. Typecheck green.

src/client/components/settings/catalog.test.ts:173 renders RootsElement over roots=[pages]: `expect(html).toContain('data-root-id="pages"')`, for every SYSTEM_ROOTS `not.toContain(data-root-id="<id>")` and `not.toContain(root.dir)`. RootsElement (src/client/components/project/RootsElement.tsx:56-57) lists only draft roots (config.roots) and emits data-root-id per row; no `.claude4spec/` text is rendered (only in comments). Hooks (useQueryClient/useMutation) are satisfied by the QueryClientProvider wrapper. The e2e test with the same slug (tests/e2e/settings-directories.test.ts:87) needs a live app; not run (app: none).

src/client/chat/settings/agentSettings.tsx:131-142: 'always-excluded' has no `visible` predicate, so it renders at every flag value. 'allowed-paths' (:127) and 'disallowed-paths' (:157) keep `visible: (ctx) => !blockDirectFs(ctx)`. SettingsCardFrame applies the shared visibleElements() filter (src/client/components/settings/registry.ts:197, SettingsCardFrame.tsx:98). Directories-card criteria stay as regression tests (catalog.test.ts:112, :173).
